summary: Discussion centers on Microsoft's potential acquisition of TikTok as part of escalating US-China tensions, Amazon's entry into the Swedish e-commerce market and its impact on local players like Lycko and BOOST, and the effects of negative interest rates on asset valuations and inequality. Markets are trading at high valuations (Atlas Copco at P30) but supported by low interest rates and stimulus measures.
key_takeaways: Microsoft considering full acquisition of TikTok in strategic shift to consumer business
Swedish e-commerce stocks like Lycko and BOOST up significantly but trading at high valuations
Amazon entering Swedish market could pressure low-priced e-commerce goods
Negative interest rates have widened wealth inequality and created asset price inflation
Earnings estimates being revised upward after Q2 reports but valuations remain elevated
